entries.source: We are so confident in the quality of this product, it comes with a life-time warranty! If your (.+?) is lost or destroyed, you can get one free replacement\. Items cannot be purchased while the vehicle is en route\.

entries.source: To make a radar booster play a noise.
entries.target: 让雷达增强器播放声音。

entries.source: To access objects placed into storage.
entries.target: 访问已放入仓库的物品。

To switch view to a player on the main monitor
entries.target: 在主监视器上切换到某名玩家的视角

entries.source: To toggle on AND off the main monitor's map cam
entries.target: 开启或关闭主监视器地图摄像头

entries.source: To transmit a message with the signal translator
entries.target: 使用信号翻译器发送消息

entries.source: To read a log, use keyword "VIEW" before its name.
entries.target: 若要阅读日志，请在名称前输入关键字“VIEW”。

entries.source: Use the "transmit" command to broadcast a text message to all crewmates.
entries.target: 使用“transmit”命令向所有船员广播文本消息。

entries.source: Other players can also use the bag while it's fastened around your waist.
entries.target: 袋子系在腰间时，其他玩家也能使用它。

entries.source: Use the "FLASH" command to cause a bright flash from the radar booster's bulb.
entries.target: 使用“FLASH”命令让雷达增强器灯泡发出强闪光。

entries.source: Use the "SWITCH" command before the radar booster's name to view it on the main monitor.
entries.target: 在雷达增强器名称前使用“SWITCH”命令，即可在主监视器查看它。

entries.source: To save batteries the extension ladder automatically stores itself after 18 seconds.
entries.target: 为节省电量，伸缩梯会在 18 秒后自动收回。

entries.source: Powered by proprietary AI software, they will get you access through any locked door.
entries.target: 由专有 AI 软件驱动，可帮助你通过任何锁住的门。

entries.source: To get through locked doors efficiently, order an <u>auto-picker</u> from the terminal.
entries.target: 若要高效通过锁门，请从终端订购 <u>自动开锁器</u>。

entries.source: To get through locked doors efficiently, order a <u>lock-picker</u> from the ship terminal.
entries.target: 若要高效通过锁门，请从飞船终端订购 <u>开锁器</u>。

entries.source: Use the "PING" command before the radar booster's name to play a special sound from the device
entries.target: 在雷达增强器名称前使用“PING”命令，让设备播放特殊声音

entries.source: Tip: This may occur due to an antivirus or other software halting the save file from being read.
entries.target: 提示：这可能是杀毒软件或其他软件阻止读取存档造成的。

entries.source: With an extra battery life and even brighter bulb, your colleagues can never leave you in the dark again
entries.target: 更长续航和更亮灯泡，让同事再也不能把你留在黑暗中

entries.target: 在雷达增强器名称前使用“SWITCH”命令，即可在主监视器查看它。它必须处于激活状态

entries.source: Use the "transmit" command to broadcast a text message to all crewmates. The message must be under 10 letters
entries.target: 使用“transmit”命令向所有船员广播文本消息。消息必须少于 10 个字符

entries.source: While moving furniture with [B], you can press [X] to send it to storage. You can call it back from storage here.
entries.target: 使用 [B] 移动家具时，可按 [X] 将其送入仓库。你可以在这里从仓库召回。
